records.name: leaf_branch_gap
records.prompt: Use case: illustration-story, reusable exact-state object vignette for MagicPaper offline learning books. Approved image is STYLE reference only: matte gouache, softly shaped hand-painted forms, tactile paper texture, contemporary children's picturebook, lilac/turquoise/coral palette. Draw ONE simple low tree branch with ONE dry ochre-coral leaf attached by its long flexible stem; beside its leaf tip is ONE short bare side twig. Keep the branch structure physically readable and uncluttered. The dry leaf hangs with a small but clearly visible EMPTY GAP between its tip and the side twig. It is NOT touching the side twig. No sound letters or motion symbols. Isolated object asset with actual transparent background; no tree trunk, no scenery, no character, no child, no ground, no aura, no drop shadow, no text or decorative sparkles. Full branch and leaf within frame. This is a concrete dry leaf and branch, not an icon. The leaf is still attached by its stem. A calm minimal horizontal composition leaving margins.
